chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked him about a man who has sores that keep bleeding continuously: how should he perform salat (prayer)? He said: "He performs salat (prayer), even if the bloods are flowing."

key_terms.الدِّمَاءُ: bloods; here referring to ongoing bleeding
key_terms.الْقُرُوحُ: sores or wounds on the body
key_terms.تَدْمَى: to keep bleeding or emit blood continuously

ai.seo_question: How does a person with continuously bleeding sores perform salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person afflicted with continuously bleeding sores. It indicates that ongoing bleeding of this kind does not prevent him from performing salat (prayer), even while the blood continues to flow.
